body:
INDEPENDENT EXACT-CANDIDATE REVIEW: BLOCK 39c745d0d43a690d86c4437ac42b5b07c1526197 on one receipt-integrity defect plus two concrete provenance-link defects.

PASS evidence. Base and sole parent are 51facdaacf75524e747faa4f53dad276cd40430d; scope is exactly 26 added files under docs-site; diff-check is clean. The scientist-first route, separate Scala and collaborator routes, maturity language, custom responsive source, text-labelled evidence grades, reduced-motion rule, and no-internal-archaeology boundary are coherent. Independent npm verify passed: Astro check 0/0/0, ten routes, Pagefind 11 HTML files, and public/artifacts/verbatim-proof.html remained exactly 1,726 bytes with SHA-256 62f03a03ed09c4fe4beeeb3ec5b0b4d8fe34bac0c411983a41e7101621582ba1. Independent isolated fixturesJVM/test passed 117/117; WarOfTheGhostsSuite itself is 31/31. Managed rendered visual QA is not claimed: the available browser plugin imports a removed versioned service module; I closed my local preview and the final browser-process audit is clean.

BLOCKER 1, exact-revision receipt is caller asserted. docs-site/src/lib/provenance.ts accepts any nonblank DOCS_SOURCE_REVISION and uses it in the visible receipt plus every source URL without checking it against the checkout. Mutation court: with the immutable checkout still at 39c745d, I set DOCS_SOURCE_REVISION to forty zeroes. npm run build exited 0, built all ten pages, and rendered Generated from 000000000000 plus blob/tree links under the false forty-zero identity across eight pages. Required repair: derive the source revision from the admitted checkout, or validate any override against the actual checked-out commit/tree before rendering; add the false-SHA mutation as a gate. An exact-source receipt cannot be authoritative decoration.

BLOCKER 2, first-use provenance points to the wrong file. scala/getting-started.mdx labels its Confirmed evidence as StorySource and SurfaceAnalyzer source but links core/.../surface.scala. Both StorySource and SurfaceAnalyzer are defined in core/.../atlas.scala. Point the evidence at atlas.scala or split the sources.

BLOCKER 3, two public evidence links contradict their labels. reference/decisions.mdx passes the directory docs/adr through the blob-only sourceLink helper, producing /blob/<sha>/docs/adr rather than a tree link. On the landing page, the Confirmed card covering the current module graph and local ONNX adapter links only README.md, whose exact text still says the repository does not include an HTTP/ONNX provider and omits embed-onnx from its module list. Link that claim to build.sbt and/or embed-onnx/README.md rather than to the contradictory README.

No repository path, candidate policy, reservation, authorization, or landing was changed by this review. A narrow successor repairing these three points should retain the otherwise strong evidence and journey.
